home.Продуктовая визуализация, коммерческие м: Product visualization, commercial materials and a consistent visual language for the brand.
home.Каталоги, карточки, товарные данные и по: Catalogues, product cards, product data and clear user journeys.
home.Специализированные GPT и AI-сценарии для: Specialized GPTs and AI workflows for recurring business tasks.
home.Структура, интерфейс и реализация лёгких: Structure, interface and implementation of lightweight websites without unnecessary technical overhead.

otutto.Визуализация индивидуальной мебели, комм: Bespoke furniture visualization, commercial materials, a specialized GPT, 3D and production references — not as separate deliverables, but as one working system for the brand.
otutto.Показывала будущую мебель до запуска в п: Visualized future furniture before it went into production.
otutto.Собирала персональные предложения и мате: Created tailored proposals and materials that helped clients make decisions.
otutto.Создала специализированный GPT для расчё: Built a specialized GPT for calculations, verification and document preparation.
otutto.Работала с визуальным языком бренда, 3D: Worked on the brand's visual language, 3D and production references.
otutto.До производства клиент видит,: Before production, the client can see
otutto.Для индивидуального дивана были согласов: For a bespoke sofa, the proportions, fabric, contrasting piping and sculpted legs were agreed in advance. The visualization became a reference for the client, the designer and the factory.
otutto.Материал и отделка зафиксированы как час: Material and finishing were fixed as part of the approved design.
otutto.В одном материале собраны визуальный обр: One piece of material brings together the visual concept, dimensions, fabric, two purchase scenarios, prepayment terms and brand arguments — everything a client needs to compare options and decide.
otutto.AI-инструмент для задачи,: An AI tool for a task
that used to be calculated manually.
otutto.ОТУТТО PRO ориентируется по загруженному: OTUTTO PRO works from an uploaded furniture price list: it finds the model, required modules and fabric or genuine-leather categories, totals the components and rechecks the result. It can calculate many configurations in sequence and quickly compare the same sofa across available materials.
otutto.Канапе 120×175 с ящиком + Пума 180×110 +: Chaise 120×175 with storage + Puma 180×110 + Bar + Corner + 90×110 recliner section + 4 headrests + 4 lumbar cushions
otutto.Одну конфигурацию можно сразу посчитать: The same configuration can be priced immediately across several fabric categories and genuine leather. The client sees real options side by side, while the manager avoids a second manual pass through the price list.
otutto.Премиальный вариант остаётся в выборе бе: The premium option stays in consideration without making the sales process more complex.
Not a collection of disconnected tasks.

forma.Товарная таблица стала понятным web-ката: A product spreadsheet became a clear web catalogue with search, sorting, variants, favourites, a cart and a ready-to-send manager enquiry — with no separate development budget.
forma.данные превращены в сценарий заказа: data turned into an order journey
forma.Исходная таблица стала структурированной: The source spreadsheet became the structured foundation of the catalogue.
forma.Категории, карточки, поиск и сортировка: Categories, product cards, search and sorting made the assortment easy to navigate.
forma.Избранное, корзина и подготовка обращени: Favourites, the cart and a prepared enquiry turned the catalogue into a sales tool.
forma.Каталог опирается на точные товарные дан: The catalogue is built on accurate product data: real variants, prices, specifications and images. Similar names must not turn into combinations that do not exist — a good interface starts with a correct data model.
forma.Поиск, основные категории, прямой выбор: Search, main categories, direct subcategory selection, sorting, pagination and real product variants are organized around one simple flow: find what you need, compare it and keep track of your choices.
forma.Цена, фото и характеристики меняются вме: Price, images and specifications change with the selected variant.
forma.Возврат назад сохраняет категорию, поиск: Going back preserves the category, search, sorting and position.
forma.Каталог остаётся рабочим на телефоне, а: The catalogue remains usable on mobile instead of merely shrinking.
forma.Избранное, просмотренные товары и корзин: Favourites, viewed products and the cart are stored locally. The cart generates a ready-to-send enquiry for the manager, and a shared link can restore selected items and quantities.
forma.Forma Home вырос из электронного каталог: Forma Home grew from an electronic catalogue into a tool that helps people navigate the assortment and prepare an order. No framework, no heavy build pipeline and no separate development budget.
